name: lackluster_firetv
title: Lackluster Plus+ - the Fire TV app

needs.why: the build tools and the art the app starts from
needs.make: copy build_apk.py, make_art.py and app\res (without values) from C:\PCodeTest\lackluster_firetv

needs.why: the Android SDK build tools (no Gradle is used)
needs.make: install Android Studio; SDK Manager -> build-tools 36.0.0, platform 34

needs.why: the Java compiler that ships with Android Studio

device.why: checks marked (on the TV) run only when LP_DEVICE names a Fire TV that adb can reach, e.g. set LP_DEVICE=192.168.0.48:5555. They install a TEST copy (ai.esteef.lacklusterplus.test) beside the real app.
